perception_loop.assessment: The session used one explicit framed look, at final QA, and it returned a clean whole-board render and measurements. There were no close-up looks during dense regional construction, and no edit followed the final render, so there was no demonstrated render-guided adjustment or render→adjust→render loop. Standing renders were available throughout by system design, but the transcript shows construction proceeding without framed regional inspection. This is the principal process weakness and aligns with the rubric's acceptable-state/single-QA-render territory rather than the 9–10 anchors.

lint_etiquette.assessment: Lint was generally handled constructively and the final QA reported DIAGNOSTICS · clean. Counting error-level lint findings when raised, 12 E-level findings appeared across APPLIED operations; all were ultimately resolved. There was no instance of the same lint re-firing for more than three consecutive turns without a strategy change, so no lint fight. No warning remained open at commit, hence there was neither a warning override requiring a verbatim reason nor a silent override.

commit_honesty.assessment: The single commit summary accurately describes the stage diff and final render. Each named subsystem is represented by corresponding objects and edges: admission/deadline rejection, routing/cache bypass, token-boundary fallback, circuit/spend controls, billing/audit, and isolated shadow evaluation. The summary does not claim visual rebalancing, completeness beyond the implemented concepts, or a fix absent from the diff. The final look was diagnostically clean, and no seen defect was committed undeclared.

economy.assessment: The committed result used 59 patch operations, with 92 total tool calls including intermediate edits, QA, and finalize. Wall time was 619.2 seconds (10.32 minutes), below the 15-minute budget, and finalize was reached far below the 300-turn budget. Most operations were proportionate to a large architecture diagram. There was one localized add–reroute–delete correction for qreturn, followed by rebuilding the intended semantics into e4; this is mild corrective thrash. Several spend-control label moves were iterative but responded to changing lint conflicts and did not involve repeated NO-OPs.

The agent deleted the just-added edge, then represented the exchange through a bidirectional e4 on turns 21–22; counted as one localized thrash cycle.
The session reached finalize successfully within 10.32 minutes and without approaching the turn budget.
